summary: Iter 11 — Full backend + frontend testing of new DM feature. Backend: 19/19 pytest tests PASS (compliance-check, /dm/send happy + edge paths, threads list, thread messages, both-participants visibility, auth gating, oversized media). Frontend: routing, profile-message-button, quick-messages, chat-thread-page render, dm-composer presence, live compliance-warning banner, two-tap arming behaviour and clean-text-no-warning all PASS. CRITICAL FRONTEND BUG FOUND: dm-send-button (and entire composer row — image button, mic button, textarea click area) is OVERLAPPED by the BottomNav, which blocks pointer events. The send button only fires when invoked via Enter key or JavaScript .click() — natural user clicks/taps land on the BottomNav. Backend send works perfectly; the message DOES post when bypassing the overlay (verified). Thread row test, share-a-post auto-send test, and image/audio attach tests are blocked by the same overlay bug.

ui_bugs.issue: BottomNav (h-16, 64px) overlaps the fixed-bottom dm-composer (height ~55px). elementFromPoint at center of dm-send-button returns the BottomNav <div>, not the send button. All composer click targets (dm-send-button, dm-image-tile, dm-start-recording) are non-interactive for a real user. Sending only works via Enter keypress in the textarea. This is a hard blocker for the DM UX.

BottomNav appears on /messages and /messages/:id routes. For an Instagram-style DM UX these routes typically hide the global bottom nav, especially since the composer needs the bottom slot. Hiding BottomNav on /messages* OR pushing the composer up by bottom-16 + adding pb-16 to messages list would both fix the overlap.

integration_issues.flow: DM send (any media type) via tap
integration_issues.issue: Cannot be exercised end-to-end via UI tap due to the overlay bug above. Verified backend integration works by sending via Enter key — message persists, appears in dm-msg-* row.

action_items: FIX overlay: either (a) hide BottomNav on /messages and /messages/:userId routes, or (b) move composer to bottom-16 and add pb-20 to the chat scroll container so the nav doesn't cover the input row. Option (a) matches Instagram-style DM behaviour and is recommended.

After overlay fix, re-test: dm-send-button click flow, dm-remove-image clear flow, dm-start-recording / dm-stop-recording swap, dm-remove-audio clear flow, /messages thread row tap → opens chat, ShareMenu share-send-dm → auto-send shared_post on ?share_post=<id> flow.

(Minor) ChatThreadPage onChange resets confirmFlagged on every keystroke — fine, but means a user who armed-then-edited-1-char will need to re-tap. Consider keeping the confirmation if flags are unchanged.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: DM block (lines 1637-1828) is clean and self-contained. Compliance regex uses word boundaries case-insensitively, dedupes, and runs on both /dm/compliance-check AND /dm/send (server re-validates). thread_key is sorted-join — deterministic. Denormalised shared_post snapshot at write time is the right call for v1 (no live join cost on read).

/dm/send size guard uses len(field_val) > DM_MAX_MEDIA_BYTES * 1.4 (~4.2MB cap on the base64 string). The problem statement says 'Image > ~4MB base64 returns 413' — verified working with a 5MB payload.

ChatThreadPage.js useEffect for share_post auto-send (lines 71-96) does not guard against StrictMode double-fire in dev (cleanup sets done=true but the cleanup runs synchronously before second mount). In production this is fine, but consider moving the param-clear to BEFORE the await to prevent any double-send race in edge cases.

ChatThreadPage.js: poll interval is hard-coded to 5000ms; no exponential backoff or visibility-based pause. If the user leaves the tab open for hours this will keep hitting the API. Acceptable for v1 but worth documenting.
MessagesPage.js + ChatThreadPage.js are using axiosInstance from App.js — good. No hardcoded URLs found in the new DM code.
Compliance word list is hard-coded in server.py — for v2 consider moving to a JSON/db config so admins can update without redeploy.

context_for_next_testing_agent: The DM backend is rock-solid (19/19 green). The ONLY blocker is the BottomNav overlapping the composer at /messages/:userId. Once the main agent hides BottomNav on /messages and /messages/:userId (or repositions the composer with bottom-16/pb-20), re-run the deferred frontend tests: dm-send-button tap, image attach + dm-remove-image, mic record (skip real audio, just check button swap if you grant mic perms or inject state), /messages thread row tap navigation, ShareMenu share-send-dm → /messages?share_post=<id> banner → tap thread → /messages/<other>?share_post=<id> → auto-send creates dm-shared-post-* row. Use Enter key as a sanity bypass to confirm backend before fix. ALSO: the auth flow expects token in localStorage under key 'token' (not 'auth_token'). The page <load> event timing out is normal background polling — use wait_until='domcontentloaded'.
rca of the issue: BUG: Composer overlay. RCA: ChatThreadPage.js renders <div class='fixed bottom-0 ... z-40' data-testid='dm-composer'> at viewport bottom. The global BottomNav (rendered by the App layout) sits at the same bottom anchor with class 'h-16 fixed bottom-0' (or similar) and a higher stacking context, so document.elementFromPoint(send-button-center) returns the BottomNav <div>, swallowing pointer events to the send button, image button, mic button, and possibly the textarea click hitbox. Reproduction: navigate to /messages/<other_user_id>, type 'hello', tap send-button — no /dm/send POST fires. Bypass: focus textarea → press Enter → /dm/send POST fires and msg appears. Mitigation: hide BottomNav on /messages and /messages/:userId routes (Instagram-style), OR raise composer above nav with bottom-16 + add pb-20 to the scroll container. Option 1 recommended for parity with the chat UX intent.
